summary: Iterates the active-vehicle array dword_7C54F0 over dword_5C329C entries; for each vehicle whose dword at offset 13000 (0x32C8) is <= 1, calls sub_4BC9B0 on the field at offset 16436 (0x4034) with arguments (1, 0). Returns the active-vehicle count. Invoked from PitTimer, consistent with a pit-close/team-ready state sweep during pit sequences.

operations.description: Seed result with the active-vehicle count dword_5C329C.
Iterate index i from 0 up to the active-vehicle count dword_5C329C.
Load the i-th active vehicle pointer from the dword_7C54F0 array into v2.
Proceed only when the vehicle's dword at offset 13000 (0x32C8) is <= 1.
Call sub_4BC9B0 on the field at vehicle + 16436 (0x4034) with arguments (1, 0) for each matching vehicle.
Refresh result from dword_5C329C at the end of each iteration.
Return the final active-vehicle count stored in result.

unresolved: Meaning of the state dword at vehicle + 13000 and the exact pit/team-ready effect of sub_4BC9B0(field, 1, 0) are unconfirmed.
Why result is re-read from dword_5C329C every iteration rather than kept stable is unclear.
Relation between dword_5C329C and the pit-close team-ready state is unconfirmed.
